# Menu

**Figma:** Popover/Default + Primitives/Popover/Item (page 815:6432), composed as an action menu  
**Import:** `import { Menu, MenuItem, MenuSeparator, MenuGroup } from "@zen/design-system";`

A button that opens a list of actions for an object: row actions in a table, a card's ⋯, an Edit or New menu. It uses the Popover surface and Popover/Item rows, follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern and floats in the overlay layer.

## Use it for
- Secondary actions on an object that don't fit as buttons (Rename, Duplicate, Move to…, Delete).
- Row actions in a Table (TableActions) and a Card's Sub-Action.
- A menu button in a toolbar or page header (Edit, Share, New) that groups related commands.

## Use something else for
- Choosing a value (sort order, status, assignee) → SelectField, Segmented or Chip variant="advanced" + Popover.
- Moving between pages → Sidebar, Tabs or Link.
- One or two actions → show them as buttons.
- A long or titled list of actions on a phone → BottomSheet type="action".
- Forms or rich content → Dialog or SidePanel.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Popover/Default | `Menu (surface)` | 240px, 4px padding, Large radius, Effect/Popover; portalled (or inside a [data-zen-overlay-root] device frame), 4px from the trigger, flips when there is no room |
| Trigger | `trigger` | an IconButton whose aria-label names the object, or a Button; it gets aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls |
| Items | `items[] {id, label, icon, caption, shortcut, danger, disabled, onSelect} · { type: "separator" } · { type: "group", label, items }` | or compose MenuItem / MenuSeparator / MenuGroup children |
| Primitives/Popover/Item | `MenuItem` | role=menuitem rows (PopoverItem itemRole="menuitem"); icon = an icon name (20px) or any element |
| Danger | `danger` | Content/Negative text and icon; last, after a separator |
| Align | `align` | start (default) · end (a trigger at the right end of a row or card) |
| Open | `open / onOpenChange / defaultOpen · onSelect(item)` | uncontrolled and closed by default; a choice, Escape, Tab and an outside press close it |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/menu.json`.

### Menu
An action menu (WAI-ARIA menu button): a trigger opens a list of actions on the Popover surface — Duplicate, Rename, Move to…, Delete. It is not a selection list: to pick a value use SelectField, or Chip + Popover for filters. The menu renders in the overlay portal (inside a device frame marked `data-zen-overlay-root`, in that frame), so a table or card that clips its overflow never cuts it off; it attaches 4px below the trigger and flips above it (or to the other edge) when there is no room. <Menu trigger={<IconButton aria-label="Actions for Invoice 1024" icon={<Icon name="icon-dots-horizontal-line" />} />} items={[{ id: "duplicate", label: "Duplicate" }, { type: "separator" }, { id: "delete", label: "Delete", danger: true }]} onSelect={(item) => run(item.id)} />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` (required) | `ReactElement` | — | The control that opens the menu: a Button or an IconButton with an aria-label (it names the menu too). It receives aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the opening keys (Enter · Space · ↓ first item, ↑ last item). |
| `items` | `MenuEntry[]` | — | The actions: items, `{ type: "separator" }` and `{ type: "group", label, items }`. Without it, compose `children`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Composable entries (`MenuItem`, `MenuSeparator`, `MenuGroup`), used when `items` is not given. |
| `onSelect` | `(item: MenuItemData) => void` | — | Called with the chosen item (after the item's own `onSelect`); then the menu closes and focus returns to the trigger. |
| `align` | `"start" \| "end"` | `"start"` | Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with: `start` (default) or `end` (a trigger at the right end of a row or card). Flips when it would leave the viewport. |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Controlled open state; pair it with `onOpenChange`. Default: uncontrolled and closed. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial state when uncontrolled. Default false. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — | Called with `true` when the trigger opens the menu and `false` when it closes (choice, Escape, Tab, outside press). |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Accessible name of the menu. Default: the trigger's name (aria-labelledby). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the floating surface. |

### MenuItem
One action row (role=menuitem) on the Popover/Item primitive. Use it inside `<Menu>` when you compose children.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Stable id, handed back to the Menu's `onSelect`. Default: the label. |
| `label` (required) | `string` | — | The action, verb first (“Duplicate”, “Move to…”). One line: a long label ends in “…”. |
| `icon` | `IconName \| ReactElement` | — | Leading icon: an icon name (drawn at 20px) or an element. Give every item of a menu an icon, or none. |
| `caption` | `ReactNode` | — | A second line with a short consequence (“Anyone with the link can view”). |
| `shortcut` | `string` | — | Keyboard shortcut shown on the right (“⌘D”). Display only: the app wires the shortcut itself. |
| `danger` | `boolean` | `false` | Destructive action (Delete, Remove): Content/Negative text. Put it last, after a separator. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Not available right now: dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys. |
| `onSelect` | `() => void` | — | Runs when the item is chosen (click, Enter or Space); then the Menu's `onSelect` runs and the menu closes. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the row. |

### MenuSeparator
A Divider between groups of items (role=separator).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the line. |

### MenuGroup
Items under a heading (role=group, labelled by the heading).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (required) | `string` | — | Small heading above the items (“Share”, “Move to”); it names the group for screen readers. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | MenuItem and MenuSeparator elements. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the group. |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type MenuEntry = MenuItemData | MenuSeparatorData | MenuGroupData
type MenuGroupData = { type: "group"; id?: string; label: string; items: Array<MenuItemData | MenuSeparatorData> }
type MenuItemData = { type?: "item"; id: string; label: string; icon?: IconName | ReactElement; caption?: ReactNode; shortcut?: string; danger?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onSelect?: () => void; }
type MenuSeparatorData = { type: "separator"; id?: string }
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space / ↓ | On the trigger: open the menu on the first item |
| ↑ | On the trigger: open the menu on the last item |
| ↓ / ↑ | Next / previous item (wraps) |
| Home / End | First / last item |
| A–Z | Next item that starts with the typed letters |
| Enter / Space | Run the focused item and close |
| Escape | Close and return focus to the trigger |
| Tab | Close and move on from the trigger |

## ✅ Do
- Name an icon-only trigger after its object, aria-label="Actions for INV-1042"; the name also labels the menu.
- Start labels with a verb and keep them to 1–3 words; end with “…” only when the action asks for more input (Move to…).
- Group related actions under MenuGroup headings or between separators; put destructive actions last, marked danger.
- Keep an action that is unavailable right now visible but disabled, with a caption that says why.
- Use align="end" when the trigger sits at the right end of a row or card.
- Confirm a destructive choice in a negative Dialog, or offer Undo, after the menu closes; focus returns to the trigger.
- Put menus straight into Table rows and Cards: the menu floats in the overlay layer, so overflow never clips it.
- On a phone, keep menus to a few short actions; longer lists, or ones that need a title, are an Action BottomSheet.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use a Menu to pick a value or show a checked state; that is SelectField, Segmented or a Chip + Popover (harness: menu/not-for-selection).
- Don't render a Menu without a trigger (harness: menu/needs-trigger), and don't open it on hover.
- Don't put inputs, toggles or several lines of text inside menu items.
- Don't open a menu from a menu item; open a Dialog or SidePanel for the next step.
- Don't hide the one action people use most behind ⋯; show it as a button.
- Don't mix items with and without icons in one menu.

## Accessibility
- Trigger: aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls; Enter, Space or ↓ open on the first item, ↑ on the last. A pointer opens the menu with focus on the menu itself.
- role=menu labelled by its trigger; rows are role=menuitem (no aria-selected) with roving focus: ↑/↓ wrap, Home/End, typeahead.
- Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger (a Dialog around it stays open); Tab closes and moves on from the trigger; choosing runs the item, closes and returns focus to the trigger unless the action moved it.
- Disabled items are skipped by the arrow keys; their caption explains why.
- Danger is never colour alone: the label says Delete or Remove.

## Content
- Verb first, sentence case, 1–3 words (“Duplicate”, “Move to…”, “Delete invoice”).
- Name the object once, in the trigger's aria-label, not in every item.
- Shortcuts are hints in the platform's notation (⌘D, Ctrl+D); wire them in the app.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon/unknown-name` | error | Icon names must exist (1,598 names that follow the Figma layer path, e.g. icon-search-medium-line); search them instead of guessing (MCP search_icons, or the Iconography page). | `zen-allow-icon-name: <reason>` |
| `menu/not-for-selection` | warn | A Menu runs actions. Choosing a value (a selected or checked item) is a SelectField, a Segmented or a Chip + Popover. | `zen-allow-menu-selection: <reason>` |
| `menu/needs-trigger` | error | A Menu has a trigger: a Button, or an IconButton whose aria-label names the object (“Actions for INV-1042”). | `zen-allow-menu-trigger: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/controlled-needs-handler` | warn | A controlled prop comes with its change handler (month + onMonthChange, value + onValueChange, open + onOpenChange, pageSize + onPageSizeChange…): without it nothing can change the value and the control is frozen, e.g. a DatePicker whose Previous/Next do nothing. Bare booleans (a fixed preview) and `x ? true : undefined` pins pass. | `zen-allow-controlled-handler: <reason>` |
